_comment: Committed flash-image and static-DRAM ceilings (bytes) per board. CI fails a board when its bramble.bin or static DRAM (data + bss) grows more than tolerance_bytes above the ceiling. This file NEVER auto-drifts: a developer updates it deliberately with scripts/ci/update-size-baseline.sh (raising a ceiling when a change legitimately grows the image, with the reason in the PR) and commits it. See docs/quality-policy.md. Seeded from ESP-IDF v5.4 local builds; the runner uses the pinned v5.4.1, so the canonical ceiling is what CI measures: if a first CI run reports different sizes, commit the CI values. tolerance_bytes (8 KiB) absorbs a patch-level toolchain delta while still catching the tens-of-KiB regressions this gate exists to stop.
